statement: You are given a binary tree. The tree is given as the array tree in level order, indexed from 0: the root is tree[0], and the left and right children of the node at index i are at indices 2i + 1 and 2i + 2. null marks a position with no node, and every position below a null must be null too.

Return its postorder traversal (left subtree, then right subtree, then the node) without recursion, using a single stack. Walk left, pushing every node you pass. When there is no current node, look at the top of the stack: if it has a right child, continue from that child; otherwise pop it and record it.
After recording a node, keep popping and recording while the new top of the stack has the node just recorded as its right child: that parent's right subtree is now finished, so the parent is due.

examples.explanation: 6 has children 4 and 9, and 18 has children 15 and 21. Each subtree is finished, children first, before its parent is recorded.
2 is the only child of 1 and has children 3 and 4. 2 cannot be recorded until its right child 4 has been.
